settings.text: A small shop with a short list of rules
We only sell things we would use ourselves, we are honest about how long delivery takes, and we answer every email. That is the whole business.

settings.heading: We test everything first
settings.text: Nothing goes on the site until we have used it ourselves.

settings.heading: Honest about delivery
settings.text: We tell you the real timeline up front, not the one that sounds best.

settings.heading: Easy to reach
settings.text: One email address, answered by a person, usually within a day.

settings.heading: Made to be used, not admired
settings.text: We started with one product and a simple rule: only sell things we would happily buy ourselves. That rule has not changed as the catalogue has grown.

settings.heading: Shipping worldwide
settings.text: Customers in more than 40 countries, all shipped free and tracked.

settings.heading: 30-day guarantee
settings.text: If it is not right, send it back. No arguments, no restocking fee.

settings.heading: One inbox
settings.text: No ticket numbers or phone trees. Just email, answered by us.

settings.heading: Get 10% off your first order
settings.subtitle: Join the list for early access to new products and subscriber-only discounts.
